description: A state variable filter with high pass, band pass, notch and low pass taken off at once, and voltage control over frequency and resonance

params.text: Sets the filter frequency, marked 0 to 10
Attenuates and inverts the frequency connector beside it, marked -5 to +5
Attenuates and inverts the resonance connector beside it, marked -5 to +5
Attenuates the second signal input before it enters the filter

inputs.text: Moves the filter frequency at a volt per octave, with no attenuation of its own
Moves the filter frequency, scaled by the level knob beside it
Moves the resonance, scaled by the level knob beside it
Audio into the filter at full level
Audio into the filter through the level knob beside it
